newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to sell three pct of KomiTEK on March 25.
newsitem.headline: Russia to sell three pct of KomiTEK on March 25.

text.p: Russia will auction three percent in regional oil company NK KomiTEK at a starting price of 1,000 rouble per 10-rouble share on March 25, the Russian Federal Property Fund said on Monday.
The government will offer 4.98 million shares in 11 lots, it said in a statement.
At the last auction of KomiTEK shares on February 16 last year three percent of the company was sold at 1,199.6 roubles per share at a starting price of 1,000 roubles.
KomiTEK owns 51 percent in its main production unit AO Komineft KNFT.RTS.
KomiTEK's authorised capital is 1.66 billion roubles.
The company produced 3.26 million tonnes of oil in 1996, of which it exported 1.17 million tonnes. The figures do not take into consideration KomiTEK's joint ventures.
